# nodalia-theme (vendored)

The Rust crate of the Nodalia Design Language, copied unchanged from
[getnodalia/nodalia-design](https://github.com/getnodalia/nodalia-design)
`packages/egui/crate` at commit `3e4b4a87d019c4e79798bee0c8239a636e301dec` (MIT, see `LICENSE`).

The local path keeps the existing release dependency layout. To update it, copy
`packages/egui/crate/src` and `Cargo.toml` from a newer nodalia-design commit and
record that commit here.
